LanguageData.LP_Engulfed.label: engulfed
LanguageData.LP_Engulfed.description: Engulfed whole in a gelatinous cube's transparent gel, unable to move and carried along by it, burned by acid every second. Defeating the cube frees you; trapped for at most 6 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskGaze.label: petrifying
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskGaze.description: Met the basilisk's gaze; the limbs are stiffening and greying from the tips. The stiffer, the slower; when fully stiff you must endure with Constitution, and failing turns you to stone. Slowly recovers once no longer being stared at. The blind are unaffected.
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskGaze.stages.0.label: stiffening
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskGaze.stages.1.label: half stiffened
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskPetrified.label: petrified
LanguageData.LP_BasiliskPetrified.description: Turned to stone under a basilisk's gaze: motionless for half a day before the stone skin flakes off.
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerToxin.label: carrion crawler venom
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerToxin.description: A paralytic venom secreted by a carrion crawler's tentacles. The more it builds up, the number the body; when full, full-body paralysis for 10 seconds. The venom is metabolized within a few hours.
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerToxin.stages.0.label: tingling
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerToxin.stages.1.label: numb
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerParalysis.label: fully paralyzed
LanguageData.LP_CrawlerParalysis.description: The carrion crawler venom has filled up; fully paralyzed and collapsed, able to move again after 10 seconds.
